affinity.title: affinity
affinity.description: Affinity/anti-affinity rules used to influence pod scheduling.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to create a HorizontalPodAutoscaler for this workload.

maxReplicas.title: maxReplicas
maxReplicas.description: The maximum number of replicas to scale up to.

minReplicas.title: minReplicas
minReplicas.description: The minimum number of replicas to scale down to.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.title: targetCPUUtilizationPercentage
targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilization percentage used by the autoscaler.

autoscaling.title: autoscaling
autoscaling.description: This section is for setting up autoscaling more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/autoscaling/

fullnameOverride.title: fullnameOverride
fullnameOverride.description: Overrides the full name of the release used to generate resource names.

dns_address.title: dns_address
dns_address.description: The IP address Gluetun's internal DNS-over-TLS resolver listens on inside the container.

dns_block_ads.title: dns_block_ads
dns_block_ads.description: Whether Gluetun's DNS blocklist blocks known advertising domains.

dns_block_malicious.title: dns_block_malicious
dns_block_malicious.description: DNS Block List Configuration - Disable if causing issues

dns_block_surveillance.title: dns_block_surveillance
dns_block_surveillance.description: Whether Gluetun's DNS blocklist blocks known surveillance/tracking domains.

firewall_input_ports.title: firewall_input_ports
firewall_input_ports.description: Allow inbound to qBittorrent through Gluetun's firewall

firewall_outbound_subnets.title: firewall_outbound_subnets
firewall_outbound_subnets.description: Allow cluster/LAN subnets outbound (DNS, updates) without leaking public traffic

pgid.title: pgid
pgid.description: The group ID (PGID) that the Gluetun process runs as.

puid.title: puid
puid.description: The user ID (PUID) that the Gluetun process runs as.

version_information.title: version_information
version_information.description: Whether Gluetun checks for and logs a newer version being available. Disabled here to avoid unnecessary external requests.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to enable VPN provider port forwarding.

provider.title: provider
provider.description: The VPN service provider to request port forwarding from. Should match vpn_service_provider.

status_file.title: status_file
status_file.description: The path inside the Gluetun container where the forwarded port number is written.

vpn_port_forwarding.title: vpn_port_forwarding
vpn_port_forwarding.description: Configuration for Gluetun's VPN provider port forwarding, used to request a forwarded port for incoming BitTorrent connections.

vpn_service_provider.title: vpn_service_provider
vpn_service_provider.description: The VPN service provider Gluetun connects through. See the Gluetun wiki for the list of supported providers.

vpn_type.title: vpn_type
vpn_type.description: The VPN protocol Gluetun uses to establish the tunnel.

wireguard_address.title: wireguard_address
wireguard_address.description: The WireGuard interface address(es) (with CIDR suffix) assigned to this client by the VPN provider.

wireguard_mtu.title: wireguard_mtu
wireguard_mtu.description: The MTU to use for the WireGuard interface. Leave empty to use Gluetun's default.

wireguard_private_key_existing_secret.title: wireguard_private_key_existing_secret
wireguard_private_key_existing_secret.description:
wireguard_private_key_existing_secret names a pre-existing Secret holding
the wireguard private key, for use instead of the plaintext
wireguard_private_key value above. Takes precedence when set.

wireguard_private_key_existing_secret_ke.title: wireguard_private_key_existing_secret_key
wireguard_private_key_existing_secret_ke.description:
wireguard_private_key_existing_secret_key is the key within
wireguard_private_key_existing_secret that holds the private key.

config.title: config
config.description: Environment-driven configuration passed to the Gluetun container. See the Gluetun wiki for the full list of supported environment variables.

image.title: image
image.description: The container image to use for the Gluetun VPN sidecar.

imagePullPolicy.title: imagePullPolicy
imagePullPolicy.description: The image pull policy controlling when Kubernetes re-pulls the Gluetun image.

resources.title: resources
resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the Gluetun sidecar container.
examples:
limits:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi
requests:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi

gluetun.title: gluetun
gluetun.description: Configuration for the Gluetun VPN sidecar that tunnels qBittorrent's traffic.

imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets
imagePullSecrets.description: This is for the secrets for pulling an image from a private repository more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/pull-image-private-registry/

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Ingress resource.

className.title: className
className.description: The IngressClass to use for the Ingress resource.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource for the qBittorrent WebUI.

hosts.title: hosts
hosts.description: A list of host rules used to configure the Ingress.

tls.title: tls
tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress, specifying secrets and the hosts they cover.

ingress.title: ingress
ingress.description: This block is for setting up the ingress for more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/ingress/

nameOverride.title: nameOverride
nameOverride.description: This is to override the chart name.

nodeSelector.title: nodeSelector
nodeSelector.description: Node selector constraints used to schedule the pod onto specific nodes.

size.title: size
size.description: The requested size of the configs PersistentVolumeClaim.

storageClassName.title: storageClassName
storageClassName.description: The StorageClass to use for the configs PersistentVolumeClaim. Leave empty to use the cluster default.

configs.title: configs
configs.description: Persistent volume used for qBittorrent's config/state directory (mounted at /config).

size.title: size
size.description: The requested size of the downloads PersistentVolumeClaim.

storageClassName.title: storageClassName
storageClassName.description: The StorageClass to use for the downloads PersistentVolumeClaim. Leave empty to use the cluster default.

downloads.title: downloads
downloads.description: Persistent volume used for downloaded torrent data (mounted at /downloads).

persistence.title: persistence
persistence.description: Persistent volume claim configuration for qBittorrent's config and downloads storage.

podAnnotations.title: podAnnotations
podAnnotations.description: This is for setting Kubernetes Annotations to a Pod. For more information checkout: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/annotations/

podLabels.title: podLabels
podLabels.description: This is for setting Kubernetes Labels to a Pod. For more information checkout: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/labels/

podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext
podSecurityContext.description: Security context settings applied at the pod level.

pgid.title: pgid
pgid.description: The group ID (PGID) that the qBittorrent process runs as, used to match ownership of mounted volumes.

puid.title: puid
puid.description: The user ID (PUID) that the qBittorrent process runs as, used to match ownership of mounted volumes.

timezone.title: timezone
timezone.description: The timezone the qBittorrent container uses for logging and scheduling.

torrent_port.title: torrent_port
torrent_port.description: The TCP/UDP port qBittorrent uses for BitTorrent traffic, also opened through Gluetun's firewall and used for VPN port forwarding.

webui_port.title: webui_port
webui_port.description: The port qBittorrent's WebUI listens on, used for the container port, Service, and readiness probe.

config.title: config
config.description: Environment-driven configuration passed to the linuxserver qBittorrent image.

image.title: image
image.description: linuxserver based image required to bind interface to the gluetun tunnel

imagePullPolicy.title: imagePullPolicy
imagePullPolicy.description: The image pull policy controlling when Kubernetes re-pulls the qBittorrent image.

resources.title: resources
resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the qBittorrent container.
examples:
We usually recommend not to specify default resources and to leave this as a conscious
choice for the user. This also increases chances charts run on environments with little
resources, such as Minikube. If you do want to specify resources, uncomment the following
lines, adjust them as necessary, and remove the curly braces after 'resources:'.
limits:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi
requests:
  cpu: 100m
  memory: 128Mi

replicaCount.title: replicaCount
replicaCount.description: This will set the replicaset count more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/replicaset/

securityContext.title: securityContext
securityContext.description: Security context settings applied at the container level.
examples:
capabilities:
  drop:
  - ALL
readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
runAsNonRoot: true
runAsUser: 1000

type.title: type
type.description: The type of Kubernetes Service to create.

service.title: service
service.description: This is for setting up a service more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/

annotations.title: annotations
annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

automount.title: automount
automount.description: Automatically mount a ServiceAccount's API credentials?

create.title: create
create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

name.title: name
name.description:
The name of the service account to use.
If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template

serviceAccount.title: serviceAccount
serviceAccount.description: This section builds out the service account more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/service-accounts/

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.title: terminationGracePeriodSeconds
terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: The number of seconds to wait for the pod to terminate gracefully, allowing the VPN tunnel and qBittorrent to shut down cleanly.

tolerations.title: tolerations
tolerations.description: Tolerations allowing the pod to be scheduled onto nodes with matching taints.

volumeMounts.title: volumeMounts
volumeMounts.description: Additional volumeMounts on the output Deployment definition.

volumes.title: volumes
volumes.description: Additional volumes on the output Deployment definition.
examples:
- name: foo
  secret:
    secretName: mysecret
    optional: false
